correctness.rationale: Use the standard two-particle unordered deleted-product cubical model for K4,4 with 28 vertices, 96 oriented vertex–edge cells and 72 oriented disjoint edge-pair squares, no cells in degree 3. The signed 96x72 boundary has rank 60 over F3, hence rational rank>=60. Construct all 18 tori as products of complementary 4-cycles; each is a 16-term closed integral 2-chain. Twelve selected torus columns indexed (0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,12,13) have determinant -1 on the explicitly specified square rows, showing independence and ambient-primitivity. This forces rank_Q boundary<=60, so kernel_Z boundary has rank 12; the full-rank primitive sublattice of Z^72 equals its kernel. Six displayed relations hold as exact integer chain equalities and have unit pivots on each omitted generator 5,11,14,15,16,17, yielding all Z relations. Independent fresh matrix construction reproduced all cell counts, rank_F3=60, determinant -1 and six exact relations. The discretized model applies because K4,4 has enough edges between essential vertices for two particles; no claim for arbitrary K_m,n.
